gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Visitor brings gaping-mouthed e's and short ascenders over big bowls, a pixel-era look best saved for big, short lines. Noto Sans Siddham follows as a plain sans with a deep central band and an s whose ends hang wide.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Visitor draws its letters as if with a marker tip, nostalgic and digital, with strokes pulled like solder through a nozzle. And Noto Sans Sinhala lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase, its curve endings keeping well apart.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Nostalgic and digital, Visitor keeps a pen-like line of constant weight, with short ascenders sitting above its big bowls. Noto Sans Soyombo adds a sizable x-height and open curves.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-sundanes: Chunky, retro, a bit gadget-like: Visitor joins its strokes at full thickness, with wide-mouthed e's. But Noto Sans Sundanese is the quieter one, with open e crossbars and almost no gap between x-height and cap height.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Blocky and nostalgic, Visitor has no calligraphic shading to guide the eye, just gaping e's and short ascenders. Noto Sans Sunuwar is a plain sans with curves that leave daylight, so a modest size lets its short ascender stems show.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-syloti-n: Pixel-age charm from Visitor, whose constant-width outline you could trace with a finger, plus wide e mouths and short ascenders. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri reads smooth, with tall x-height and an a that opens up.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Visitor has no thick-thin flicker to catch the eye, only gaping e's and short ascenders over big bowls. And Noto Sans Syriac supplies tall, rounded lowercase bowls and s shapes that turn wide and easy.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-syriac-e: Visitor is stout, each stroke like a drawn pipe cleaner. Noto Sans Syriac Eastern sets its tall lowercase against small caps, curve endings staying well apart, which gives that chunky heading a gentler partner.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-syriac-w: Gaping e mouths and strokes like solder pulled through a nozzle mark Visitor, its constant-width outline easy to follow. Noto Sans Syriac Western is a plain sans with terminals held far from the stroke, a modern, clean foil.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Retro and unshaded, Visitor has no stress in any curve, and its e's gape wide. Noto Sans Tagalog turns that into a pleasing contrast, its middle zone dominating each line while its curves stay generous.
